capabilities: Post short entries to a social-style timeline
Save each post as a code block in the daily note
Pin posts and daily checklists to the top
Attach images and show link preview cards
extras: Needs Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin enabled; link previews request the linked web page to fetch preview data; Windows, Linux and Android are listed as untested.
problem: Jotting quick thoughts into daily notes has no casual, chronological feed, so small entries feel like formal note-taking.

relations.evidence: Wrot was inspired by these projects.

summary: Micro-journaling timeline that saves short, tweet-style posts as code blocks inside Obsidian daily notes.
